title: Commit
subtitle: What to do with your working copy changes. Understand jj's commit workflow.
whatToDo: What to do with these changes?

commit.desc: Add a description to the WC, finalize it, and create a new empty WC on top. Equivalent to jj describe + jj new.

split.desc: Interactively split WC changes into two commits. An editor opens to select files/hunks for the first commit. The rest stays in the new WC.

squash.desc: Absorb WC changes into the parent commit. Equivalent to git commit --amend. WC becomes empty but retains its change ID.

describe.desc: Set or change the WC description (commit message). Neither DAG structure nor files change.

splitSim.title: Split Simulator
splitSim.subtitle: Visually simulate how jj split divides your WC changes.
splitSim.noChanges: No changes in WC — cannot simulate split
splitSim.instructions: Click files to assign them to Commit 1 or Commit 2. In a real jj split, you can split at the hunk level.
splitSim.step2: An editor opens to select changes for the first commit
splitSim.step3: Save and close — selected changes go to a new commit, the rest stays in WC
splitSim.step4: Split specific files only: jj split path/to/file
splitSim.gitNote: In git, this requires multiple steps: git reset HEAD~ → git add -p → git commit → git add -A → git commit. jj split does it in one command.
